questions.question:
**Direction: In the following questions, choose the word opposite in meaning to the given word.**

Conducive
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '__**Unfavourable**__'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word 'Conducive' is an adjective; it means **making a certain situation or outcome likely, possible or favourable**.

 
 
• For example,* **A quiet room is a more **conducive **atmosphere for studying*.
 
 
 
• The marked option 'Unfavourable' means** ****not giving you an advantage or a good chance of success**.
 
 
• For example,* **Current conditions in the state are very **unfavourable **for new businesses*.
 
 
 
• So, we can say that '**Unfavourable**' can function as the opposite word of '***Conducive***.'

*Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Favourable **⇒ giving one the advantage or good chance of success.
 
• **Propitious **⇒ giving or indicating a good chance of success.
 
• **Opportune **⇒ (of a time) especially convenient or appropriate for a particular action or event.

questions.question:
Direction: Select the correct **ANTONYM **of the given word.

**Refrained**
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"Acquiesce".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Refrained means ​'to stop oneself from doing something; to not do something (**कुछ करने से अपने को रोकना; कोई खास काम न करना**)**'.**

 
 
• Example: *Himesh has **refrained **himself from criticizing the government in public.*
 
 
 
• Marked option 'Acquiesce' means ​'to accept something without argument, although one may not agree with it (**बिना विरोध किए कुछ भी मानने को सहमत होना**)**'.**
 
 
• ​Example: *The bank **acquiesced **to an extension of the loan.*
 
 
 
• The word 'Acquiesce' best expresses the opposite meaning of the given word 'Refrained'.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Abstain **means to stop oneself from doing something that one enjoys (**अपने आप को कुछ ऐसा करने से रोकने के लिए जिसे करने में आनंद आता हो**). 
 
• **Desist **means stop doing something; cease or abstain (**कुछ करना बन्द करना; बंद करना या टालना**).
 
• **Abjure **means to promise publicly or formally that one will give up or not accept a belief or a way of behaving (**औपचारिक अथवा सार्वजनिक रूप से मत अथवा आचरण का सशपथ त्याग करना; शपथ लेकर त्याग करना, छोड़ने की शपथ लेना**).

questions.question:
Choose the appropriate antonym for the highlighted word in the given sentence.

That saintly man bears his tormentors no __malice.__
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Benevolence'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Malice** means the desire to harm someone or ill will.

 
 
• Example- I bear no **malice** towards anybody. 
 
 
 
• **Benevolence** means the quality of being well-meaning or kindness.
 
 
• Example- His calm tone suggested a man of deep **benevolence.**
 
 
 
• These two words are clearly **opposite** **in meaning. **
 
• Hence, **'malice' **and **'benevolence'** are antonyms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bitterness**, apart from meaning a sharpness in taste also means anger and disappointment at being treated unfairly.

 
 
• Example- He expressed **bitterness** over his dismissal without notice.
 
 
 
• **Animosity means** strong hostility.
 
 
• Example- He no longer felt any **animosity** towards her.
 
 
 
• **Distress **means extreme anxiety, sorrow, or pain.
 
 
• Example- To his **distress, **​he saw that she was trembling.

• ​Let's look at the meaning of the given options.
 
 
• **​kind: **a group of people or things having similar characteristics.
 
• **persuasive: **good at persuading someone to do or believe something through reasoning or the use of temptation.
 
• **calm: **not showing or feeling nervousness, anger, or other strong emotions.
 
• **naive: **(of a person or action) showing a lack of experience, wisdom, or judgment

• ​**Example**: *The captain was **calm **__and composed before he came on to take the crucial penalty for his team.*
 
 

​Hence, the correct answer is **option 3.**

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The kids have been __pestering__ me to buy them new toys.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**pacifying**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**pestering**' is '**pacifying**'.
 
• **Pestering**: to annoy somebody, for example by asking him/her something many times. [व्‍यक्ति को परेशान कर देना (एक बात को अनेक बार पूछ कर या अन्‍य प्रकार से)]
 
 
• *Example: to **pester** somebody for money...*
 
 
 
• **Pacifying**: to make somebody who is angry or upset be calm or quiet. (किसी नाराज़ या परेशान व्‍यक्ति को शांत एवं स्थिर करना)
 
 
• *Example: If he **pacifies** him skilfully enough, he might even make another sale on his colleague's behalf.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *pacifying.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **perturbing**: to make somebody worried or upset. (किसी को चिंतित या परेशान कर देना)
